runtime_architecture.fighting_style_data: RE4Constants.FeatureMetadata.GameData.FightingStyleCatalog is canonical for Dark Step/Electric/Water Kung Fu; RE4Constants.StyleMeta derives runtime fields from it
runtime_architecture.fighting_style_action: Progression Auto Get and Items Use/Equip share RE4StyleProgress.StartDealerAction -> MoveDealer -> Invoke -> ownership/equip verification
runtime_architecture.fighting_style_dealer_resolution: live/template NPC resolver -> shared TeleportDirectory -> exact per-Sea/style cache -> island anchor only as bootstrap -> exact dealer rescan
runtime_architecture.dealer_anchor_policy: WorldTopology island anchors are never cached or treated as dealer positions
runtime_architecture.items_fighting_equip_mount: RE4StyleProgress is release-scoped, then RE4StyleProgress:MountUseControls(RE4Tabs.Items) mounts controls into the current window; stale UseUI.Mounted state is not reused across builds
runtime_architecture.bisento_v2_requirements: Own Bisento V1 + personally deal >=10% of Greybeard max HP + Greybeard defeat; Bisento equip not required
runtime_architecture.bisento_v2_confirmation: event-driven PlayerGui upgrade-message capture + explicit inventory/live variant evidence + bounded post-kill verification
runtime_architecture.fighting_style_sea_source: RE4RuntimeContext.Core.SeaNumber exported by Core and consumed by RE4StyleProgress
runtime_architecture.items_fighting_equip_visibility: Only styles whose StyleMeta.Seas includes the authoritative current Sea are mounted; mount state itself is fresh per release/session
runtime_architecture.second_sea_access: Level 700+ -> Military Detective -> Key -> live Frozen Village door -> Ice Admiral -> return Military Detective -> Experienced Captain -> TravelDressrosa
runtime_architecture.second_sea_npc_resolution: shared RE4TeleportDirectory exact live/template NPC target; WorldTopology island anchor is bootstrap-only while NPC is unresolved
runtime_architecture.second_sea_state_policy: monotonic worker state; Ice Admiral Humanoid.Died/progression completion advances post-boss flow and prevents rollback to the door step

root_cause: Basic Fighting Style data existed twice (FightingStyleCatalog and literal StyleMeta fields), creating drift risk.

Exact dealer targets resolved during Progression were not retained. If the NPC/template became temporarily unresolvable during Items Equip, MoveDealer degraded to the generic island anchor and could end with dealer_not_loaded.

notes: 2.0.19 fixes a cross-release UI lifecycle bug: RE4StyleProgress no longer reuses UseUI.Mounted/UseJobs from an older build in the same server.
Auto Quest Sea 2 now models the documented post-Ice-Admiral steps instead of jumping from door/boss state directly to TravelDressrosa.
No live Roblox runtime is available in the build container; NPC streaming, remote acceptance and world teleport must still be smoke-tested in game.

update_2_0_15.root_cause: ui.lua suppressed the Fighting Style · Equip source section and rerouted its Use/Equip controls into curated Fighting Style sub-sections. Runtime equip logic remained in main.lua, but the expected Items section disappeared from presentation.

root_cause: The Fighting Style Equip controls were mounted from the First Sea Shop initialization path rather than from the RE4StyleProgress domain that owns StartUse/StartDealerAction. This made the expected Items section dependent on unrelated shop/presentation bootstrap behavior even though the equip runtime still existed.

Bisento V2 detection treated absence of explicit variant fields as Unknown and the old automation did not model Greybeard personal damage eligibility or capture the server upgrade notification, so the flow could kill Greybeard without ever reaching a confirmed V2 state.

fix.bisento_upgrade_notification_watcher: FeatureRuntime token-owned DescendantAdded connection; cleaned on OFF/restart
fix.post_kill_verification: bounded 3.5s; at most one forced inventory probe per second

update_2_0_17.root_cause: 2.0.16 introduced BisentoV2SessionConfirmed/Evidence reads through RE4State, but this release architecture has no RE4State variable. ResolveBisentoVariant is called by early UI ownership refresh in the core domain, before progression initialization, causing BOOT 05 to abort with attempt to index nil.

root_cause: The direct Items Fighting Style mount introduced in 2.0.16 rendered every style in every Sea, while StartDealerAction still rejected out-of-Sea metadata with wrong_sea.

RE4StyleProgress derived its Sea from cross-domain World1/World2/World3 globals instead of consuming an authoritative value exported by the Core domain, making the Use/Equip gate more fragile than the Progression/UI foundation.

RE4StyleProgress used RE4StyleProgress = RE4StyleProgress or {...}; when a newer build was executed in the same server, stale UseUI.Mounted=true caused MountUseControls to return early, so Items showed no Fighting Style Equip controls.

Auto Quest Sea 2 treated Frozen Village door state as the whole progression state. After Ice Admiral it could call TravelDressrosa without returning to Military Detective or resolving Experienced Captain, and boss/map streaming could make the worker fall back to an earlier branch.
